name: AVG Logistics Limited
about: AVG Logistics Limited engages in the provision of logistics services in India. The company offers multimodal transportation, including road and rail services to logistics solutions; and first-mile, mid-mile, and last-mile connectivity services. It also provides road transportation comprising full truck load (FTL) and less than truck load (LTL) solutions; rail logistics; cold chain, such as temperature-controlled transportation, warehousing and storage, real-time monitoring, and custom packaging; and end-to-end cold chain services. In addition, the company offers value-added services, such as labelling and assembly, reverse logistics, last-mile distribution, co-packing and packaging, inventory management, e-commerce fulfilment, and customised supply chain solutions; and technology enabled logistics, including WMS, fleet tracking, shipment visibility, and real-time monitoring services. Further, it provides warehouse solutions, which includes tech-enabled operations, optimized supply chain management, data-driven performance, customer-centric focus, specialized cold chain logistics, and industry-specific expertise; and residential relocation, commercial and office relocation, packing and unpacking, secure storage, and vehicle transportation packers and movers services, as well as warehouse management and rental, and parcel delivery services. Additionally, the company offers industrial liquid logistics and third-party logistics; dedicated/ secondary solutions; express delivery; and door to door services. AVG Logistics Limited was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Delhi, India.
